options.name: assignment_group
options.description: The name of the group that the change request is assigned to. Required if I(state) value is C(assess) or C(authorize) or C(scheduled) or C(implement) or C(review) or C(closed). Mutually exclusive with C(assignment_group_id).

options.name: assignment_group_id
options.description: The sys_id of the group that the change request is assigned to. Required if I(state) value is C(assess) or C(authorize) or C(scheduled) or C(implement) or C(review) or C(closed). Mutually exclusive with C(assignment_group).

options.name: attachments
options.description: ServiceNow attachments.

options.name: category
options.description: The category of the change request. Default choices are C(hardware), C(software), C(service), C(system_software), C(aplication_software), C(network), C(telecom), C(documentation), C(other). One can override them by setting I(change_request_mapping.category). Hard-coded choices for C(category) were removed in 2.5.0.

options.name: change_request_mapping
options.description: User mapping for I(Change request) object, where user can override Choice Lists values for objects.

options.name: close_code
options.description: Provide information on how the change request was resolved. The change request must have this parameter set prior to transitioning to the C(closed) state.

options.name: close_notes
options.description: Resolution notes added by the user who closed the change request. The change request must have this parameter set prior to transitioning to the C(closed) state.

options.name: description
options.description: A detailed description of the change request.

options.name: hold_reason
options.description: Reason why change request is on hold. Required if change request's I(on_hold) value will be C(true).

options.name: impact
options.description: Impact is a measure of the effect of an incident, problem, or change on business processes. Default choices are C(high), C(medium), C(low). One can override them by setting I(change_request_mapping.impact).

options.name: instance
options.description: ServiceNow instance information.

options.name: number
options.description: Number of the record to operate on. Note that contrary to I(sys_id), I(number) may not uniquely identify a record.

options.name: on_hold
options.description: A change request can be put on hold when I(state) is not in the C(new), C(canceled), or C(closed).

options.name: other
options.description: Optional remaining parameters. For more information on optional parameters, refer to the ServiceNow change request documentation at U(https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/tokyo-it-service-management/page/product/change-management/task/t_CreateAChange.html).

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority is based on impact and urgency, and it identifies how quickly the service desk should address the task. Default choices are C(critical), C(high), C(moderate), C(low). One can override them by setting I(change_request_mapping.priority).

options.name: requested_by
options.description: User who requested the change.

options.name: risk
options.description: The risk level for the change. Default choices are C(high), C(moderate), C(low). One can override them by setting I(change_request_mapping.risk).

options.name: short_description
options.description: A summary of the change request.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the change request. If I(state) value is C(assess) or C(authorize) or C(scheduled) or C(implement) or C(review) or C(closed), I(assignment_group) parameter must be filled in. For more information on state model and transition, refere to the ServiceNow documentation at U(https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/tokyo-it-service-management/page/product/change-management/concept/c_ChangeStateModel.html) Default choices are C(new), C(assess), C(authorize), C(scheduled), C(implement), C(review

options.name: sys_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the record to operate on.

options.name: template
options.description: Predefined template name for standard change request. For more information on templates refer to ServiceNow documentation at U(https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/tokyo-it-service-management/page/product/change-management/concept/c_StandardChangeCatalogPlugin.html) or find template names on <your_service_id>.service-now.com/nav_to.do?uri=%2Fstd_change_producer_version_list.do%3F

options.name: type
options.description: Specify what type of change is required.

options.name: urgency
options.description: The extent to which resolution of an change request can bear delay. Default choices are C(high), C(medium), C(low). One can override them by setting I(change_request_mapping.urgency).
